mechanism: Norethindrone may increase amitriptyline plasma concentrations through CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 inhibition, while amitriptyline may reduce norethindrone efficacy through enzyme induction and increased hepatic metabolism.
action: Monitor for amitriptyline toxicity (anticholinergic effects, sedation, cardiac conduction changes); counsel patients on consistent oral contraceptive use and consider backup contraception during amitriptyline initiation or dose changes.
